stories.title: Ewloe Green homes to lose power from 11pm for underground cable fault repair
stories.summary: Homes in Ewloe Green will have their power switched off at 11pm tonight so SP Energy Networks can carry out emergency repairs to an underground cable fault. stories.title: Ken Skates accuses Plaid Cymru Government of “looking at snatching” free school milk
stories.summary: Welsh Labour leader Ken Skates has accused the Plaid Cymru Government of looking at snatching free milk from schoolchildren, as a consultation on the future of school milk in Wales runs until January. stories.title: Police find no threat to public after report of suspicious activity in Greenfield Valley
stories.summary: North Wales Police found no threat to the public after a report of suspicious activity in Greenfield Valley Heritage Park on Tuesday morning. stories.title: Funded childcare now open to every two-year-old in Flintshire
stories.summary: Every two-year-old in Flintshire can now get 12.5 hours a week of funded childcare, wherever in the county they live. Until this week the places were only open to families in Flying Start areas, a list of 51 parts of the county including parts of Flint, Holywell, Connah’s Quay, Shotton, Mold, Buckley and Sealand. stories.title: Fewer than four in 10 high-risk eye patients in north Wales waiting within target
stories.summary: Fewer than four in 10 of Betsi Cadwaladr’s highest-risk eye patients were waiting within their target time at the end of September, the lowest rate of any health board in Wales.
